concerns.text: T002 reads `data/dataset_with_metrics.csv`, but no task produces this file. T001 produces only raw CIFs and source_verification.json; the SMILES extraction/generation (FR-002) and PC computation (FR-003/FR-010) steps that would create dataset_with_metrics.csv are not assigned to any task. The implementer cannot execute T002 without a producer for its declared input.

T003/T004 produce and validate `data/dataset.csv` against dataset.schema.yaml, but that schema REQUIRES `fingerprint_vector`, which is only created in T005. As ordered, T004's verification ('exits 0 on full validation success') is unexecutable — validation will always fail on the missing required column. Either validate a pre-encoding column subset, split the schema, or move full-schema validation after T005.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 vs spec.md:FR-003 vs data-model.md:Transformation Logic
concerns.text: T002 instructs dropping pc_raw outside [0, 1], but the spec defines PC = ΣV_vdW/unit-cell volume (typically 0.5–0.75) while the data model defines pc_raw = unit_cell_volume/ΣV_vdW (typically >1). The implementer cannot deterministically pick the formula or the filter bounds; the two definitions give opposite filter outcomes. Root cause is a spec/data-model contradiction that must be resolved before T002/T003 are executable.

T012 has no verification clause. Every other task names a checkable outcome; T012's 'write a concise methods/results account' needs at least a verifiable condition (e.g. summary.md exists, links resolve to the named artifacts, all reported metrics match validation_report.json values).

T001 proceeds with the COD URL while plan.md declares the missing verified URL a blocking issue with all phases pending. An implementer following plan.md would refuse to run T001. The tasks doc must state which authority wins (it asserts the URL is now accepted) and the plan's blocking status must be reconciled, or T001 is not executable per the plan.

T007 computes and reports Pearson r unconditionally, but FR-006 says Pearson r is reported only if Shapiro-Wilk indicates normal residuals, while validation_report.schema.yaml makes pearson_r a required field. The implementer cannot satisfy all three simultaneously; specify the resolution (e.g. always compute, conditionally interpret) in the task.
